t: The Funhouse Mirror and the Wish That Backfired
s: This article explores AI's 'amnesiac genie' nature, contrasting its confirmation bias as a societal danger and a development advantage. It highlights the critical role of architecture, language choice, and persistent memory systems in building robust AI applications that transcend current limitations.
sub: AI confirmation bias as both a bug (social echo chambers) and a feature (curated development environments)
Architectural principles for system robustness (persistence, anti-fragility, informed language choice)
AI's persistent memory systems (keychain, discussion database) overcoming the 'amnesiac genie' problem
Browser automation and session hijacking as AI embodiment ('eyes, brain, hands')
Comparison of AI model updates (monthly vs. daily, full retraining vs. LoRA)
